newsitem.title: FINLAND: MOTOR RACING-LEHTO AND SOPER WIN WORLD GT RACE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LEHTO AND SOPER WIN WORLD GT RACE.

text.p: Finland's JJ Lehto and Briton Steve Soper won the latest round of the World GT championship for BMW McLaren on Sunday after transmission failure had cost Roberto Ravaglia victory.
BMW were in sight of a one-two finish until Ravaglia was forced out late in the race, allowing Soper to sweep through to win by three laps from Porsche.
The factory BMW team's success owed much to their decision to run the three-hour race on a one-stop refuelling strategy. Most other teams made two stops.
Former Formula One driver Lehto said: "We had planned on two stops but when both Mercedes had trouble we could cruise a little to save fuel and waited until half distance."
The Roock Porshce of Ralf Kelleners and Stephane Ortelli inherited second place to finish three laps down.
Pre-race favourites Mercedes were eliminated early in the race, Alexander Wurz crashing after a collision with McLaren's Thomas Bscher and Alessandro Nannini halted by gearbox failure.
